value.rationale: Environmental switching frequency changes a biologically meaningful survival outcome although each static environment is linearly lethal; the exact strictly monotone season-length boundary rules out multiple survival windows for the natural two-patch recruitment model. Coupling the sharp spectral boundary to unique annual attractor and universal 1/t critical extinction coefficient yields a reproducible benchmark and separates qualitative ecological persistence from finite-time numerical simulation. Restriction to equal seasons and common crowding is explicit.
